properties.name: maple.framework.rabbitmq.config-source
properties.description: RabbitMQ config source. local: load rabbit.yml from classpath or ./config/<profile>/; nacos: pull rabbit.yml from Nacos at startup when server-addr is configured.

properties.name: maple.framework.rabbitmq.scheduler.expose
properties.description: Whether to expose the rabbitTaskScheduler as a TaskScheduler bean. Set false to keep the Spring Boot default task scheduler.

properties.name: maple.framework.rabbitmq.thread-pool.core-size
properties.description: Core thread count of the async channel-setup executor.

properties.name: maple.framework.rabbitmq.thread-pool.max-size
properties.description: Max thread count; only effective when the queue is full, or immediately when queue-capacity <= 0.

properties.name: maple.framework.rabbitmq.thread-pool.queue-capacity
properties.description: Queue capacity of the async executor; <= 0 uses a synchronous queue so max-size takes effect immediately.

properties.name: maple.framework.mq.rabbitmq.enable
properties.description: Enable the default RabbitMQ queue listener.

properties.name: maple.framework.mq.rabbitmq.default-queue-name
properties.description: Queue name consumed by the default listener; overrides spring.rabbitmq.default-queue-name.
